description_en: You can call SetZoneRecordStatus to set the status of a DNS record for a zone. This enables or pauses DNS resolution
description_zh: 调用SetZoneRecordStatus设置域名（Zone）析记录状态，启用或暂停解析
name: SetZoneRecordStatus

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.

en: English.

The default value is en
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

zh：中文。

en：英文。

默认值：en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DNS record
parameters.name: record_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the DNS record. Valid values:

ENABLE: Enables DNS resolution.

DISABLE: Pauses DNS resolution
parameters.help_zh:
解析记录状态。取值：

ENABLE: 启用解析
DISABLE: 暂停解析
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value. The value must be unique among different requests and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

RecordId.description_en: The ID of the DNS record

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request

Status.description_en:
The status of the DNS record. Valid values:

ENABLE: DNS resolution is enabled.

DISABLE: DNS resolution is paused
Status.description_zh:
当前解析记录状态。描述：

ENABLE: 启用解析
